name: WF-30 — GG Relacionamento — Inteligência de Contato e Abordagem

parameters.query: SELECT a.cnpj, a.razao_social, a.employees_count, a.months_revenue_12m, a.payroll_active, a.billing_active, a.pix_active, c.id as contact_id, c.contact_name, c.role as contact_role, c.phone, c.email, c.is_decision_maker, c.key_interests, c.known_objections, c.last_contact_at FROM pj_accounts a LEFT JOIN pj_account_contacts c ON a.cnpj = c.cnpj ORDER BY a.months_revenue_12m DESC;
